stories.title: Interrumpida la circulación de Alta Velocidad entre Barcelona y Madrid por el incendio en la máquina de cola de un tren en Ricla (Zaragoza)

en.title: High-speed rail traffic between Barcelona and Madrid interrupted due to train engine fire in Ricla, Zaragoza
en.summary: A fire in the rear engine of a high-speed train caused an interruption to rail service between Barcelona and Madrid near the town of Ricla in Zaragoza province.

stories.title: El Supremo confirma la suspensión del censo de la 'ley de nietos': no podrán votar

en.title: Supreme Court confirms suspension of 'grandchildren law' census: they will not be able to vote
en.summary: Spain's Supreme Court maintained the suspension of a voter registry related to the 'grandchildren law' ahead of November elections, as the administration failed to properly separate approved from rejected naturalization cases.

stories.title: La 'burbuja antipitidos' del desfile no libra a Sánchez de una lluvia de abucheos e insultos

en.title: The 'anti-whistling bubble' at the parade does not spare Sánchez from a barrage of jeers and insults
en.summary: During Spain's National Day parade, Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez faced widespread booing and insults from crowds along the route, though officials in a separated viewing area were largely shielded from the noise.

stories.title: Un incendio en un AVE de Renfe interrumpe la circulación en la línea de alta velocidad Madrid-Barcelona

en.title: A fire on a Renfe high-speed train interrupts traffic on the Madrid-Barcelona high-speed line
en.summary: A fire on a high-speed train near Ricla in Zaragoza caused a disruption to service on the Madrid-Barcelona line, resulting in the evacuation of 283 passengers.

stories.title: El Supremo mantiene la suspensión del voto para la 'ley de nietos': "El riesgo de que se constituya irregularmente un censo de electores persiste con la misma intensidad"

en.title: Supreme Court maintains suspension of voting for 'grandchildren's law': 'Risk of irregularly constituting an electoral census persists with the same intensity'
en.summary: Spain's Supreme Court rejected the government's appeal to lift a suspension on a voting measure, ruling 5-1 that risks of improper electoral registry formation remain unchanged.

stories.title: Interrumpida la circulación del AVE entre Barcelona y Madrid por el incendio de un convoy

en.title: AVE high-speed train service between Barcelona and Madrid interrupted due to convoy fire
en.summary: High-speed train service between Barcelona and Madrid was halted after a train caught fire, with videos showing intense flames but no reported injuries.

stories.title: Los estadounidenses Robert E. Hall y Michael Woodford ganan el Nobel de Economía

en.title: Americans Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford win Nobel Prize in Economics
en.summary: The Swedish Academy awarded the 2026 Nobel Prize in Economics to Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford for research on how fiscal and monetary policies stabilize economic fluctuations.

stories.title: Malestar en el Gobierno tras la decisión del Supremo sobre la ‘ley de nietos’: “Parece que el derecho a voto no es tan relevante para algunos”

en.title: Government discontent following Supreme Court decision on 'grandchildren's law': "It seems that the right to vote is not so relevant for some"
en.summary: The Interior Minister criticized the Supreme Court's decision while the opposition party praised it as a check on alleged government attempts to influence the electoral registry.

stories.title: Sánchez confirma que buques de guerra marroquíes entraron en aguas de Ceuta a finales de julio

en.title: Sánchez confirms that Moroccan warships entered Ceuta waters in late July
en.summary: Spain's government president acknowledged that Moroccan naval vessels were present near the autonomous city of Ceuta in late July, coinciding with a large influx of migrants.

stories.title: El TS mantiene la suspensión del voto para los nacionalizados con la 'ley de nietos'

en.title: Spain's Supreme Court maintains suspension of voting rights for naturalized citizens under the 'grandchildren law'
en.summary: The court upheld the suspension preventing new registrations for the election, though it permitted voting rights for those already registered under the Democratic Memory law before August 1.

stories.title: El Supremo mantiene para el 29-N la suspensión del derecho al voto de los nacionalizados por la ‘ley de nietos’

en.title: Supreme Court maintains suspension of voting rights for naturalized citizens under the 'grandchildren law' for November 29 election
en.summary: Spain's highest court rejected an appeal by the state prosecutor and gave affected individuals, numbering over 163,000, five days to submit arguments regarding voting rights suspension.

stories.title: Michael Woodford y Robert E. Hall ganan el Nobel de Economía por sus propuestas para suavizar crisis y burbujas

en.title: Michael Woodford and Robert E. Hall win Nobel Prize in Economics for proposals to mitigate crises and bubbles
en.summary: The Nobel Prize recognized their research on stabilizing the economy through monetary or fiscal policy measures.

stories.title: Berkeley se dispara un 59% en Bolsa en cuatro sesiones

en.title: Berkeley soars 59% on stock exchange in four sessions
en.summary: Berkeley's stock rose over 6% following a previous gain exceeding 14%, driven by the announcement that the company will propose José Bogas, former Endesa chief executive, as board member at its November 18 shareholder meeting.

stories.title: Interrumpida la Alta Velocidad entre Barcelona y Madrid por la avería de un tren en Ricla

en.title: High-speed rail service between Barcelona and Madrid interrupted due to train failure in Ricla
en.summary: A high-speed train bound for Figueras broke down near Ricla in Zaragoza, requiring the evacuation of 380 passengers. One passenger received medical assistance for dizziness.

stories.title: El promotor de Operación Chamartín incrementa un 81% sus pérdidas en 2025

en.title: Operación Chamartín promoter increases losses by 81% in 2025
en.summary: The company's revenue reached 2.2 million euros, representing a 1.5% increase compared to 2024, while losses grew significantly.

stories.title: Citroën resucita el mítico 2 CV y asegura que seguirá siendo "sencillo, ligero y muy barato"

en.title: Citroën revives iconic 2 CV and assures it will remain "simple, lightweight and very affordable"
en.summary: Citroën presented an electric prototype of the 2 CV, with the production model expected to launch in 2028 at a starting price of approximately 15,000 euros.

stories.title: El Brent se da la vuelta y vuelve a superar los 107 dólares

en.title: Brent oil reverses course and surpasses 107 dollars again
en.summary: Brent crude oil reversed its morning decline and gained 0.75%, rising above 105 dollars per barrel after initially falling to 103.5 dollars.
